English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false Are there government jobs to generate income by working from home? Posts circulating on social media carrying a letter with the national logo claimed to employ individuals from all districts of the island and allowing them to work from home. The required age limit and contact details were included in the letter as well. by Anonymous | April 29, 2024 At first glance, the letter seemed to be an official one issued by the government, and many had expressed their views on the said letter, so FactSeeker stepped in to investigate. When fact checking via FotoForensics and Forensically, it was evident that the national logo was edited into the letter. Furthermore, when official notices are published by the government, the name of the organisation or ministry publishing the notice, the date of publication, and contact details for further inquiries must be included in the published document. The said letter does not carry most of the required information. Government news sources too investigated the matter by examining cabinet decisions and extra ordinary gazettes, and disclosed that the letter was fraudulent. Further confirmations were provided by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Presidential Secretariat that the letter was not an official letter. FactSeeker confirms that the letter circulating on social media carrying the national logo claiming to employ individuals from all districts to be fake. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
